title: Welcome to Quiet.md
p: Quiet.md is a quiet place for your notes. No account, no cloud workspace: every document is a file on your Mac. Jot down a thought, or work through something complex with headings, lists, tables, code and images.

These guides will help you find your way around in about ten minutes. They were written in Quiet.md, so every layout you see is something you can make yourself. Feel free to edit them. They are working examples, not a read-only manual.

callout.p: The best way to learn is to try things as you read. For a blank space to experiment, open Playground.

img.caption: Home: your documents at a glance

p: The window has two main areas.

ol.li: The sidebar contains Home, Pinned, My documents and Settings. Press ⌘ ] to hide or show it.
The document is the white writing surface. Its header contains the page path and title, with More, Search and New controls on the right.

p: Documents with headings also have an outline near the top left of the page. Click a heading to jump to it; the current section is highlighted as you scroll.
Work through this list. Click a checkbox to mark an item complete, or place the cursor on it and press ⌘ Enter.
checkbox: Press ⌘ N to create a document and give it a title
Type / on an empty line and insert a task
Select a few words and use the floating toolbar to make them bold
Type ## to turn a line into a level-two heading
Press ⌘ J, search for “Tables”, and open Tables and columns
Right-click a document in the sidebar and pin it
p: Your changes save automatically after a short pause. If a save fails, the header shows an error so you can deal with it before leaving the document.

column.p: Type / on an empty line to insert a block. Keep typing to filter: try /table or /code.
Type # for a heading or - for a list. Wrapping words in **bold** applies bold as you finish typing.
Use ⌘ B for bold and ⌘ ⌥ 1 for a heading. Press ⌘ / to see the available shortcuts.

p: Read them in order, or jump straight to what you need.

p: Your documents are stored in ~/Documents/Quiet.md. Each document is an XML file in docs; images and attachments are stored in assets. Back up the whole folder with Time Machine or copy it to another Mac.

blockquote.p: Writing and reading local notes do not require a network connection. Remote images can access the network when loaded; you can control automatic downloading in Settings.

p: For backup and migration details, see Import, export and back up.
Ready to start? Open Writing: text, headings and paragraphs.
